name: LitzGen - PCB Litz coil generator
description: Generate, check and simulate transposed multi-layer PCB Litz coils.
description_full: LitzGen generates concentric multi-bundle PCB Litz coils (the dual-bundle 4-layer architecture of Kale & Wicht, WPTCE 2026, and its generalisation to any layer and column count) as tracks, arcs and blind/buried vias. It checks strand-to-strand clearance itself, simulates inductance, AC resistance (skin, proximity, via losses), Q and strand current sharing, and exports FastHenry and openEMS models. Requires numpy in KiCad's Python.
